official_definition: Super Digivolution: Condition - (When Attacks) By returning this Spirit to the Hand, summon a Condition "Ultimate" family Spirit card from your Hand without paying the cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Super Digivolution] or [Super Digivolution: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Super Digivolution]", "give [Super Digivolution]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
